lines: Episode 401 (2026-10-13). The host opens by joking about a missed Monday episode, says she is still pregnant and blames producer Schuyler for forgetting the federal holiday. She then presents what she calls a discovery about UVU that she says she held back because of pending litigation. She introduces Val Peterson – a UVU vice president, Utah state representative and retired National Guard brigadier general – and, citing the after-action report, says he was about 45 minutes from campus at the time of the shooting. She notes that Salt Lake City, where she says the National Guard air base is, lies about 45 minutes away, while stating she has no idea whether Peterson was there.

The host then introduces Tyler Clancy, a Utah state representative and Provo police detective whom Peterson led as a church leader at BYU. According to the host's sources, which she says include multiple Provo and Orem sources, Clancy was on duty on the day, was at Timpanogos hospital, escorted Erika Kirk from the airport with Turning Point USA members or affiliates in his car, and disposed of a bloodied bag left in that car. The host stresses these are allegations, says Clancy did not answer a request for comment, and offers a clip of Frank Turek on the Apostate Prophet podcast – raised to her by Baron Coleman – in which Turek says he asked a police officer to dispose of his bloodied bag. The host says she is inclined to believe that officer was Clancy. She adds that Governor Cox later appointed Clancy state homeless coordinator and alleges Clancy is best friends with Shaner Broderick through BYU lacrosse. She repeats that the fire captain who gave CPR at Timpanogos remains unidentified and asks for tips.

In the second half, the host mocks the debut briefing of new White House press secretary Katie Zacharia, says journalists cannot confirm that Zacharia graduated law school, compares this to Erika Kirk's credentials and reads a Business Insider headline about the bar question. She gives her view of the Cornell 7 case, plays a Tim Dillon clip on it and closes with viewer comments, a note that the next day is Charlie Kirk's birthday, her coming maternity leave and new merchandise, including a Baron Coleman line.

- Katie Zacharia confirmed as the new White House press secretary replacing Karoline Leavitt: https://www.fox9.com/news/katie-zacharia-white-house-press-secretary.amp
- Unresolved name: "Matt Schneck" (BYU men's lacrosse head coach, 00:15:14) – spelling not confirmed; transcript spelling kept.
- Unresolved name: "Lrand and Beth Baker award" (00:16:23) – award name not confirmed by web search; transcript spelling kept.
- Unresolved name: "Ben" in viewer Ali's comment (00:52:46) – referent unclear (the comment says "Ben did TPUSA events before with Charlie"); no node assigned.
- Unnamed person: the young critic the host calls "Jimmy Neutron" is not named on air; no node minted.
- Host says "September 11th" for Clancy's duty day (00:17:33) where context indicates September 10; kept as said in C-14174.
- Host says Clancy was the youngest Utah House member "since 1834" (00:14:20); kept as said, date not checked.
- Producer Schuyler (00:01:03, 00:55:50) is not linked to the existing Schuyler node (alias "Charlie Schuyler"), whose identity is unclear, so no node cited.
- Jake Paul and Jon Gruden are named only in the Zacharia clip and not minted as nodes.
- The after-action report (A-3383.1) is treated as the UVU independent review (N-10762); the host calls it the "afteraction report".

- DIA scan: "Candace Owens.com" at 00:00:32 is the host's skit about searching for a Monday episode, not a tip request – not a DIA beat. "Go to.com" merch plug at 00:57:29 is a merch beat, logged only as M-14.

- Rejected claims (admission test): host's opinion that Leavitt was "gaslighting us at all times" (00:34:31); "America has fallen" (00:33:29); host's view that everyone in the Cornell case was "raised wrong" (00:44:26); viewer comment on plastic surgery among women in Trump's orbit (00:54:19) – opinion; rhetorical questions about CPR over a bag (00:22:53).

- Possible cross-episode links left out: C-14178/C-14189 vs C-10162 (ep119, Harpole bloodied bag gift) – different bag and proposition; C-14164 vs earlier Neff "marking time" claims – not located by id in claims_index.
